evals.prompt: 帮我做一个蓝牙耳机充电盒的三视图，宽60mm高45mm深25mm，外壳是磨砂白色塑料，正面有一个LED指示灯和一个按键
evals.expected_output: A structured image-gen prompt (SUBJECT/DESIGN/GEOMETRY/etc) respecting 60x45x25mm proportions, white matte plastic, LED + button on front, plus plain-English layout note.

evals.prompt: I want an orthographic three-view sheet for a minimalist mid-century wooden accent chair — no dimensions given, just make it look like a nice design piece.
evals.expected_output: A structured prompt with estimated/inferred dimensions clearly marked as estimated, mid-century wood details, plus layout note.

evals.prompt: I only have a front-facing photo of this speaker (imagine a cylindrical speaker with a grille and one visible button on front). Can you generate the three-view orthographic sheet for it?
evals.expected_output: Should ask a short clarifying question about the unseen back/side geometry (or reasonably note it's inferring a plain cylindrical back) rather than inventing detailed hidden features, per the skill's conservative-inference rule.
